subject: Re-sequence: staged 90/45 blocks to onboard governance stakeholders
message_1_subject: Re-sequence: staged 90/45 blocks to onboard governance stakeholders
message_1_body:
Hi Laura,

Thanks again for the time yesterday. After internal alignment we learned that Helios has added two governance reviewers (security lead + procurement reviewer) who want to join the runthrough. Given travel for a couple of your execs and our infra SME availability, we'd like to propose re-sequencing the session into two contiguous blocks instead of one 90-minute slot.

Suggested approach:
- Day 1 (90 minutes): product demo + platform/infra Q&A (target audience: product, platform, infra)
- Day 2 (45 minutes): governance deep-dive (security + procurement + legal), narrower scope, minutes recorded

Benefits: gives the security and procurement teams a focused agenda, avoids blocking your travel-heavy attendees for an extended session, and lets us surface any follow-ups ahead of procurement review.

I attached a quick runbook and a pre-demo checklist — they include the proposed agenda, required attendees, and a short list of technical artifacts the security team usually requests.

Can you confirm if a staged two-block approach works for Helios and whether Raj (info-sec) and your procurement contact can make Day 2? If so, we'll send calendar holds and update the invite with a short pre-read.

Best,
Marissa
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com
+1 (415) 555-0192

Attachments: runbook-staged-schedule.pdf, pre-demo-checklist.xlsx
message_2_subject: Re: Re-sequence: staged 90/45 blocks to onboard governance stakeholders
message_2_body:
Thanks Marissa — that plan sounds sensible.

Quick notes from our side:
- Raj (cc) is our InfoSec lead and can do Day 2 at either 10:00–10:45 PT on Wed or 14:00–14:45 PT on Thu. He has an audit offsite Wed afternoon, so earlier in the week is preferable.
- Procurement is still finalizing the internal PO cadence; they asked if you could provide a 30-minute slot for pricing & contract Qs after Day 2.
- Two of our product folks will be traveling Mon–Wed next week, so they prefer Day 1 to be Thu morning.

Can you propose two date options (one where Day 1 is Thu AM and one with Day 1 Fri AM) so we can lock travel and internal reviewers? Also please include any security evidence links we should pre-populate for Raj.

—Laura
VP Product, Helios Systems
laura.chen@helios.com

Laura — thanks for the fast reply. Two quick constraints from my side:
1) I'll be onsite with another customer Wed afternoon => prefer Thurs morning for Day 1.
2) Our infra SME (Diego) is available Thu 09:00–11:30 PT or Fri 08:30–12:00 PT; if Day 1 is Thu AM we can cover platform deep-dive and leave Day 2 for Raj/procurement later the same week.

Proposed concrete options:
Option A (preferred):
- Day 1: Thu 2026-03-25 09:00–10:30 PT (product + infra)
- Day 2: Fri 2026-03-26 10:00–10:45 PT (security + procurement + 30-min optional follow-up for PO/terms)

Option B (alternate):
- Day 1: Fri 2026-03-26 09:00–10:30 PT
- Day 2: Mon 2026-03-29 11:00–11:45 PT

I'll send calendar holds for Option A tentatively; if Helios confirms Raj and procurement availability we will convert to confirmed invites and share the security evidence bundle beforehand.

—Vivek
Director, Solutions Architecture, Redwood Inference

Best,
Marissa
